title: Frame research around a product decision
guidance: Define the product decision, material uncertainty, evidence needed, method, and stopping condition before gathering sources or examples.
rationale: A decision frame prevents broad research summaries and makes it possible to judge whether additional evidence changes the design.
applies_when: desk research, benchmarking, discovery, or validation is requested
avoid_when: the user asks for a simple factual lookup with no design decision
required_evidence: the decision the research must inform
acceptance_checks: The research output names the decision it informs
Findings end in implications and unresolved uncertainty

title: Treat competitor patterns as contextual evidence
guidance: Record what a comparator does, the context and apparent purpose, its limitation, and the resulting hypothesis. Do not turn frequency into user need or copy a pattern without task evidence.
rationale: Common competitor behavior can reflect imitation, legacy systems, commercial pressure, or dark patterns rather than a validated user requirement.
applies_when: competitive benchmarking or analogous-product review is used
avoid_when: a normative platform requirement already determines the behavior
acceptance_checks: Competitor observations are separated from design recommendations
No pattern is justified only by popularity

title: Classify the artifact before selecting a structure
guidance: Identify whether the work is a marketing page, public-information site, transaction, product interface, dashboard, expert tool, or safety-critical system before selecting layout and interaction defaults.
rationale: Artifact types optimize for different tasks; applying a conversion-page structure to an operational interface produces irrelevant hierarchy and calls to action.
applies_when: a new page, flow, product, or substantial redesign is being structured
avoid_when: the artifact type and approved structure are already explicit
acceptance_checks: The selected structure matches the stated artifact type
Operational interfaces do not inherit marketing-page sections

title: Design public institutional sites around authority and findability
guidance: Prioritize public tasks, authoritative content, transparent provenance, predictable navigation, multilingual behavior, and accessible document or data access before promotional conversion patterns.
rationale: Public-information users need to locate and trust authoritative material; sales CTAs, hidden governance content, and decorative storytelling can obstruct that job.
applies_when: the site represents a government, sovereign, museum, regulator, or public institution
avoid_when: the scoped surface is explicitly a commercial campaign
acceptance_checks: Primary public tasks are reachable without sales language
Governance and source context are findable
Language switching preserves location and meaning

title: Preserve expert-tool efficiency and direct manipulation
guidance: Design expert tools around stable work areas, persistent selection and context, precise controls, shortcuts, undo, inspection, and density appropriate to repeated use.
rationale: Consumer-style cards and progressive hiding can increase navigation and memory cost for expert users who compare, manipulate, and inspect many objects.
applies_when: the product is a canvas, editor, IDE, operations console, or frequent-use professional tool
avoid_when: the target audience is novice and the task is rare or linear
acceptance_checks: Selection remains visible across relevant actions
Primary commands have efficient pointer and keyboard paths
Actions expose undo or safe recovery where feasible

title: Preserve human review, override, and traceability
guidance: For high-consequence recommendations, show the recommendation, rationale, source and uncertainty; require an appropriate review step; support modification or rejection; and record the final human decision without implying certainty.
rationale: A persuasive recommendation without provenance or meaningful control can produce automation bias and obscure accountability.
applies_when: AI or decision support affects clinical, financial, legal, security, or other high-consequence work
avoid_when: the output is low-risk, easily reversible, and clearly exploratory
acceptance_checks: Users can inspect the basis of the recommendation
Users can modify or reject it when their role permits
The final human decision and source state are traceable

title: Structure dashboards around decisions and exceptions
guidance: Identify the decisions, comparisons, exceptions, time context, and drill-down path before choosing KPI cards or charts. Use a number, table, map, network, or chart according to the relationship users need to inspect.
rationale: A dashboard that starts from available metrics often creates redundant cards and charts without supporting an operational or executive decision.
applies_when: designing or redesigning analytical, operational, or executive dashboards
avoid_when: the surface is a static report with a mandated structure
acceptance_checks: Every prominent metric or visualization supports a named decision
Time range, source, units, and comparison context are available
Summary-to-detail navigation preserves context

title: Choose theme from context rather than industry stereotypes
guidance: Select light, dark, or high-contrast behavior from brand, environment, content, platform, user preference, and task—not from an industry label.
rationale: Industry-to-theme mappings can contradict explicit brand requirements and make public, data-heavy, or safety-critical content harder to interpret.
applies_when: a visual theme or palette is being selected
avoid_when: the brand or user has already selected and validated the theme
acceptance_checks: The theme rationale names product context rather than industry alone
Semantic colors and contrast are verified independently per theme

title: Build distinctiveness around one coherent signature
guidance: Commit to one product-specific visual or interaction signature and make hierarchy, type, color, imagery, density, and motion support it. Reject unrelated fashionable treatments.
rationale: Combining several current visual trends produces generic AI-styled interfaces; a constrained signature creates recognizable character without sacrificing clarity.
applies_when: creating a new visual direction or materially redesigning an interface
avoid_when: the active design system already defines the direction and no deviation is authorized
acceptance_checks: The direction can be described as one coherent thesis
Decorative treatments reinforce rather than compete with the primary task

title: Model critical states before declaring a flow complete
guidance: Specify the relevant loading, partial, empty, stale, error, validation, timeout, retry, permission, success, cancellation, interruption, and undo behavior alongside the ideal path.
rationale: State gaps cause task failure and data loss even when the primary screen appears polished.
applies_when: designing an interactive flow, form, editor, dashboard, or asynchronous action
avoid_when: the artifact is a static communication with no state change
acceptance_checks: Critical failure and recovery states are specified
User input and context are preserved when recovery permits
Repeated or conflicting actions are handled safely

title: Preserve meaningful relationships across widths
guidance: Choose responsive behavior from content and task relationships. Define what wraps, scrolls, stacks, collapses, persists, or becomes another representation without automatically forcing every interface into one column.
rationale: Naive stacking can destroy comparisons, table identity, map context, and control-to-object relationships.
applies_when: the interface spans viewports, zoom levels, orientations, or text sizes
avoid_when: the product is intentionally fixed to a controlled display
acceptance_checks: Critical content and controls remain available at scoped widths and zoom
Comparison and object-control relationships are preserved or have an equivalent view

title: Inspect the rendered experience before completion
guidance: Open the actual implementation, exercise the critical path and relevant states at meaningful breakpoints, capture material failures, correct causes, and inspect again.
rationale: Source review cannot reveal all layout, timing, focus, content, rendering, and interaction failures.
applies_when: code or an interactive prototype is created or changed
avoid_when: the requested deliverable is intentionally non-interactive research or strategy
acceptance_checks: The actual rendered artifact was inspected
Critical interactions and states were exercised
Corrections were re-inspected
